name: close
description: Run an accounting close start to finish for any client and any period. Readiness check, reconciliations, transaction cleanup, adjusting entries, ASC 606 revenue recognition for subscription and services contracts, a reviewer pass, and a delivered close package with a Word close memo that opens on the executive summary, working from trial balance and general ledger exports out of any accounting system.

co.kick.close.note: Every skill under skills/ is self-contained; per-skill reference docs ride inside each skill folder. commands/ holds slash-command wrappers. Conformant Agent Plugins v1 clients load the eleven skills under skills/ directly.
